facts.business: IFGL Refractories Limited is an Indian multinational company providing refractory solutions for the iron & steel, foundry, cement, lime, and coal gasification industries worldwide.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Shareholders' approval for appointment of Mr. M P Bajoria as Additional Director on 24th May 2025 was obtained 4 days subsequent to expiry of stipulated period under Regulation 17(1C) of SEBI LODR Regulations.

key_risks: Delay in obtaining shareholders' approval for director appointment beyond regulatory timeline
Concentration of revenue from two external customers contributing more than 10% each at standalone level
facts.related_party_note: Remuneration details of directors include related party disclosures; investments in subsidiaries IFGL Worldwide Holdings Limited and IFGL-Marvels Refractories Limited are marked as related party transactions; agreement with Marvels International Group Co Ltd and Marvel Refractories (Anshan) Company for greenfield manufacturing facility.
